name: PROV Representation Base
abstract: Cross-reference anchor for the W3C PROV data model (PROV-DM), shared by every concrete PROV serialization/representation profile (PROV-N, PROV-XML, PROV-JSON, PROV-O/RDF, PROV-JSONLD). This block carries no concrete syntax of its own; each representation-specific sibling block declares `isProfileOf` this one and supplies its own schema/context/examples.

sources.title: PROV-Overview: An Overview of the PROV Family of Documents
